title: Speaking redesign verified at phone widths
summary: Checked the Arabic redesign in a real browser at 320, 390 and 768 pixels. Practice is visible without scrolling and tips open on demand.

changes.detail: Added an explicit accessible label to the practice action after the browser check exposed icon text in its name; replaced slash-based step numbering with localized wording for RTL readability.
Verified compact hero, expandable guidance and focused practice layout.

validation.name: Typecheck and focused ESLint
validation.detail: TypeScript and ESLint passed for the redesigned screen.

validation.name: Interactions and history
validation.detail: Speaking interaction test passed in three languages, including expand/collapse and notes retained across returning to tips; six history tests passed.

validation.name: Browser visual check
validation.detail: Disposable Edge browser with mocked authentication: no horizontal overflow at 320/390/768; practice action above fold; accordion, practice entry and keyword input worked. Reviewed Arabic landing and practice screenshots. Final step-label wording checked by interaction test.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: Native devices, dark-theme visual QA and production deployment not tested. Browser authentication was mocked; no real credentials used.
